outlook: Grains closed sharply higher Tuesday on strong fund and technical buying across the whole complex, helped by a weaker U.S. dollar. November soybeans gained 22 cents to $13.03 and December corn rose nearly 11 cents to $5.08 as harvest runs behind normal (corn 23%, soybeans 25% done) and wet weather raised disease and yield worries ahead of Friday's USDA reports. Minneapolis December spring wheat climbed 11 cents to $7.20 and Chicago wheat gained 12 cents, with late Plains winter wheat planting and Black Sea export disruptions in focus. Minneapolis cash bids rose with futures while basis held unchanged; canola's closing figure was not available, so the earlier quote is shown.
